description:
Get a library document's metadata and content.

    Content is markdown, raw HTML (content_type text/html), or a signed URL for PDFs.

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_library_item
title: Get library item
